newsitem.title: FRANCE: French aid workers missing in Russia.
newsitem.headline: French aid workers missing in Russia.

text.p: Four French nationals, three of them aid workers, are missing in Russia's Dagestan republic in the north Caucasus, the relief organisation Equilibre said on Tuesday.

"These four people, three of whom are expatriate workers for Equilibre and the other a friend of the director of the mission, did not return to their office on Monday in Makhachkala," the capital of Dagestan, said an Equilibre spokesman.
The four men had been in Dagestan, a small republic in the extreme southeastern corner of the Russian Federation, for several months to aid refugees from neighbouring Chechnya.
Both Equilibre and the United Nations High Commission for Refugees have sent representatives to the capital to look into their whereabouts.
A number of foreign relief workers have been kidnapped for ransom in and around Chechnya in recent months.
